facts.fact: The 2026/27 (EFY 2019) federal budget appropriates ETB 1,484,839,300 to the Ministry of Innovation and Technology (recurrent 680,339,300, capital 804,500,000).
facts.system: Ministry of Innovation and Technology budget 2026/27

facts.fact: In FY2024/25 the Ministry of Innovation and Technology was voted ETB 2,754,552,330 and spent ETB 989,820,128, or 35.9%, per the document.
facts.system: Ministry of Innovation and Technology budget 2024/25

note: The Digital Foundation Project had zero appropriation in FY2024/25 and was donor/loan financed (spent ETB 7.04bn adjusted budget), so it gives no fact; 2024/25 and 2026/27 votes are not consecutive years, so no rose/fell.
